avis.titre: The Biggest Visible Change I’ve Seen in My Skin in Years
avis.texte: ✨If I could only keep one skincare product, it would honestly be these pads.✨ Even after trying peels, tools, clay masks, exfoliants, and retinol, this is the most noticeable improvement I’ve seen in my skin. I’m in my 50s and have tried a lot of skincare over the years — pore strips, clay masks, exfoliants, retinol, you name it. Very few products have made a noticeable difference in my skin, but these absolutely have. My biggest concern has always been the pores on my nose. They’ve looked enlarged for years and it’s something I’ve been self-conscious about. After using these pads, the difference was surprisingly visible — my pores looked tighter, my skin texture smoother, and my nose looked noticeably clearer. I added a close-up photo because this is where I’ve seen the biggest difference — my pores look visibly tighter and clearer What impressed me most is that I saw improvement right away, but the results actually kept getting better with consistent use. After about a month, my skin looks more refined overall and my nose pores appear much smaller than they used to. I also have sensitive, combination skin, so I’m careful with exfoliating products. These have been very gentle for me. The pads are thin but well saturated (not dripping), and I like using the textured side first to exfoliate, then flipping to the smooth side to finish. There’s no strong fragrance and they haven’t irritated my skin. Another unexpected benefit is how much better my makeup applies now. Foundation

avis.texte: If you have red or easily irritated skin just get them!! My skin absolutely hates me most days. Even washing my face can sometimes cause it to revolt against me. I wear makeup mostly everyday, I regularly use actives in my evening and morning skincare routines, I'm lax on reappling sunscreen throughout the day (yes, I know I need to remember to do that) and many other things, so I put my skin through the ringer on a regular basis. Out of all of the skincare I have (and I have a lot) these have come in handy quite often since I got them. I use them as mini face masks mostly on my cheeks to help cool down and reduce the redness after cleansing in the mornings and evenings. I let them sit for about 10ish minutes and then rub the excess over the rest of my face. In the mornings I do use my hypochlorous acid spray and aha toner before hand and let them both dry down before putting these on and the evenings I use these after my tretinoin/differin dries down. They do have a cooling feeling after they are on for about a minute which to me and my raging skin feels lovely. By the time the serum dries down in the mornings and I apply the rest of my skincare it has not affected my makeup application or the longevity at all. These and the rest of the anua toners (I own 4) are really the only new things I have added into my routines lately and I can definitely tell a difference in my skin. avis.titre: Brightening, Smoothing, and Perfect for Daily Use
avis.texte: The Anua Niacinamide 5% TXA Toner Pads are a standout if you’re chasing that clear, refined, glass‑skin look. Each pad is generously soaked and has a soft, cushiony texture that feels gentle even around the under‑eye area. The blend of niacinamide + tranexamic acid (TXA) works beautifully for brightening — especially if you deal with dullness, uneven tone, or shadowy under‑eyes. The dual‑action formula gives light exfoliation while keeping the skin hydrated, and the pads leave a fresh, non‑sticky finish. With consistent use, skin looks smoother, pores appear tighter, and there’s a noticeable boost in clarity. They’re easy to use, travel‑friendly, and ideal for a quick morning or nighttime refresh. If you want daily pads that brighten, refine texture, and support that luminous glass‑skin effect, these are a reliable and effective choice.

I like it. This product is very easy on the skin so would probably be good for sensitive skin. There’s a good amount of pads to last you a month. It hasn’t caused any breakouts. I wouldn’t say I’ve seen much change in my pores since using it though. I will likely repurchase just because I feel like it does help with moisturizing without causing pimples.

Really enjoying this product. The individual pads come with a tweezers to pick them up; the product is functional and easy to use. Pads are generous in size. I can tone by entire face, neck/neck and even have some moisture left in each pad to run over my hands and arms. Texture of pad is nice and the hyaluronic acid is not sticky at all. Does a great job toning and moisturizing. I haven't tried other companies who provide similar product, but wouldn't be compelled to do so as happy with this one.

avis.titre: Perfect for my 52 post-menopause mature skin
avis.texte: I really love these toner pads. I use Torriden and Medicube pads regularly, and these Anua ones are noticeably a bit bigger — which I actually appreciate. The larger size makes them great for sweeping across my whole face or using as little “spot masks” on areas that need extra attention. For my 52-year-old, post-menopause mature skin, these work beautifully. The niacinamide + TXA combo gives a nice brightening effect without any irritation, and the pads leave my skin hydrated and fresh without being sticky. I especially like using them in the morning because they give a healthy glow and sit well under makeup. The pads themselves are soft, cushy, and much sturdier than some other brands. Overall, these have become one of my favorite brightening pads — a great addition to my routine, and definitely something I’ll repurchase.

avis.titre: Refreshing Glow Pads That Leave Skin Hydrated and Smooth
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Anua PDRN + Hyaluron Glow Pads for a few weeks now, and I’m very impressed with the results. The pads are soaked with just the right amount of essence, making them easy to apply without dripping. My skin feels instantly refreshed, hydrated, and soft after each use. The hyaluronic acid provides deep moisture, while the PDRN gives my skin a healthy, radiant look. I also love that the pads are gentle enough for daily use — no irritation, just smooth and glowing skin. The container comes with plenty of pads (60), so it’s a great value for the price. Overall, these glow pads are a wonderful addition to my skincare routine. They’re perfect for both morning and evening use, and I would definitely repurchase them. Highly recommended for anyone looking for hydrated, radiant skin!

I have tried a few toner pads including some of the most popular brands, but this one is my favorite so far. My tip of using toner pads is to flip all pads upside down and start using the bottom ones first for better essence amount soaked in each pad and keep the rest for a longer time. The exfoliating side of the pad is really gentle which does not irritate my sensitive skin (on tretinoin treatment). This toner is perfect for the first layer of toner, if you layer multiple toners like me. So soothing and I can always rely on days that my skin is extra sensitive.

avis.titre: Very hydrating - great for dry or rough patches
avis.texte: I ordered these Anua toner pads because my skin responds well to the ingredients, and I’ve been happy with other Anua products I’ve tried in the past. These pads can be used as a 10-20 minute spot treatment, and afterward, I use the same pad to wipe down the rest of my face (and sometimes my elbows if there's extra toner left, lol). I’ve been using two each morning after washing my face, while I go about my routine. First of all, the toner is pink. I mention this because when I saw the pads, I assumed the pad itself was pink (it’s actually white). The color can transfer onto white towels or clothing, so just be aware of that if you're using them while getting ready. Fortunately, it washes out easily and there's no staining. The pad is a good thickness and is fully saturated with toner. It sticks fairly well to the skin. Out of the 20 I’ve used, only one fell off - this one was near my mouth, and I was talking on speakerphone at the time. The toner leaves my skin looking hydrated and refreshed. It does feel slightly sticky as it dries, but since I use moisturizer and sunscreen after, it’s not an issue for me. Overall: Very convenient as a spot treatment, especially if you have dry patches or combo skin. There's some minor stickiness, as well as the color transfer issue, is worth noting, but I'd definitely use them again in the future.

Why did you pick this product vs others?: I am an esthetician and I love Cica and Azelaic acid, and because this had both ingredients together, I had to try it. It did not disappoint! It is one of my favorite finds because it does all the things it claims to without irritation. Cica/centella/madecassoside is one of the most underrated ingredients (in USA) in my opinion and I love trying products with multiple levels and extracts all in one, like this one. It shows its presence because it is so calming, hydrating, and restorative. In the picture of my chest, I had sun exposure the day before and had just gotten out of a hot shower and my skin was inflamed. I swiped the toner pads across my face, neck, and chest, and it immediately calmed some of the redness. You can see a visible line of reduced redness and dewy hydration where the serum is swiped versus where it is not! It’s wonderful. I have already recommended it to someone else because I like it so much. I have used every other day for about 10 days and it did not break me out, cause dryness or irritation, or produce any rashes. As with all Azelaic acid, go slow and increase use gradually, and always wear sunscreen to avoid irritation. This is gentle, but still has potential to irritate people with sensitive or delicate skin if you go gung-ho out the gate. The serum may be sticky for those with oily skin, but will feel super hydrating for normal and dry types. If it feels too sticky, try it at night when your skin needs an

These pads come in a container that rests in another container, so there is a lot more plastic than there needs to be. The pads themselves are very thin, and you pull them out with tweezers (included). I found trying to get just one to come out at a time was nearly impossible, so I have to stuff a few back in every time I try to get one out. These haven't irritated my skin and don't leave any tacky residue. There is also no smell I could notice. These do help even my skin a bit; I'll need to use them over a longer period for any dramatic results, but that is true with any face product. There is plenty of moisture with these, so they tend to stick to your face well. I have found it best to apply them where needed and then lie down for a bit so they stay in place and work their magic. I do find them soothing, and they seem to hydrate my face, so I would consider reordering.

I like the convenience of this toner pad combination from the ANUA Store. The name of this particular toner pad is Anua PDRN 100 Hyaluronic Acid Pad. The product comes in a greenish hue container in a nicely designed box. The toner pads and the accompanying serum are well-protected. To access the product, you need to unscrew the lid and remove a tough paper seal on top. There's also a plastic tweezer-like tool included for easy and hygienic removal of the toner pads. The pads are made from a gauze-like material and are thinner than typical toner pads. This design allows for the compression of 60 pads into a compact container. Additionally, there is ample toner serum to keep the pads from drying out. This toner-pad combo is expensive compared to the competition. A container with 60 toner pads costs $22.00 (as of July 14, 2025), which brings the unit cost down to 37 cents per pad.

avis.titre: Gentle toner pads that are perfect for those with sensitive skin
avis.texte: Having very sensitive skin, I need to be selective when it comes to skin products. Some are hit or miss. It’s a disappointment when ordering a product that I can only use once because it’s too harsh for my skin. Also, I’m middle-aged so I need to take care of my skin more to keep it healthy. This is why I ordered this dual-sided toner with hyaluronic acid as it seems like a gentle product that would work well with my skin. MY EXPERIENCE WITH THE PRODUCT 1. I was very pleased when I first received it as it comes with 60 pads. I also like the container. 2. The pads are soaked well with the solution. It also comes with a tool to pick up the toner pads. 3. I noticed that the pads seemed a bit thin for a toner pad. 4. When I use it on my face, it glided very easily. I felt that it’s almost like a serum instead of a toner in terms of consistency. 5. I didn’t use it like an exfoliator like I do with other toners with thicker pads. 6. I really like the scent. It’s very light. 7. It didn’t take long for the product to absorb and it felt very nice on my skin while it was drying. 8. I then used a serum and moisturizer afterward to complete my routine. OVERALL IMPRESSION: I really like this toner pad. I feel that it’s very gentle for my sensitive skin. It didn’t feel harsh at all. My face felt healthy afterwards. I think that this is a very good product for me to use daily unlike some of my other toners that tend to make my skin drier when I use them daily. I believe that it’s cost effec

This Anua PDRN 100 Hyaluronic Acid toner pads arrived in a sealed box. The container is big and includes a convenient pad picker. Each pad is thick and well saturated with toner/gel/serum, almost to the point of dripping. After cleansing at night, I apply one pad and leave it on for 3–5 minutes. It takes a bit of time to fully absorb so I typically use it on weekends when I have more time. One pad is more than enough to cover my face and neck. This product feels instantly refreshing, soothing, and hydrating. It’s gentle on the skin, has a subtle nice scent and no irritation after a week of use. I also like the detailed product information available online esp. the ingredient list, clinical study data and the zoomable box details. Recommended! Why did you pick this product vs others?: Great ingredients and I'm familiar with this brand. Skin softness: Gentle on skin. Cleanser: This can also serve as a follow up cleanser. Effectiveness: It provides instant hydration. Still need to wait for few more weeks to see the long term effects. Value for money: It is within the normal price range for high quality toner pads. Skin care: Great option to use for skin routine depending on skin condition. Ease of use: These toner pads are so easy to use and convenient.

avis.titre: OMG! It’s like a tub of mini face masks!
avis.texte: These are amazing! I turned around and immediately grabbed the PDRN version of these pads and am ridiculously excited to try those as well! Ok….so these are seriously like large round “sheets” that I swear are like mini face masks. They look, feel and work just like one. They’re thin, hug the skin perfectly and are just a bit under 3” inches big so they cover my entire cheek. And the tub contains 110 of them! After wearing one of these for the recommended 10 minutes my skin was firm and bouncy and my pores looked noticeably tighter. It didn’t leave me feeling sticky or coated with anything either. Maybe it took a bit to absorb? I really wasn’t paying too much attention to that but what I do know is that afterwards my skin feels clean and as if free of product. I’m a huge fan of face masks and use them all the time. These pads from Anua are so good that I suspect I’ll wind up using these instead. Well, except for the collagen masks I pamper myself with on occasion. Oh! And the ingredients are all great! Plus it comes completely factory sealed. These really are a game changer for me.

avis.titre: Easy to Use, Effective, Well Thought Out Packaging
avis.texte: I'm reviewing Anua Azelaic 10 Hyaluron Redness Soothing Pads, Troubled & Spot Care with Korean toner pads, Azelaic acid, Hyaluronic Acid, Korean Skin Care, 90 pads. These round soothing pads are pale green in color (see photo) with little to no scent as described. The pads are wet and fully saturated with liquid, but not drippy. The instructions suggest leaving the pad in place for 5 to 10 minutes. These lightweight pads are easy to use, stayed in place, and are comfortable to use. I have some redness on and around my nose and found these pads to be soothing. These pads come in a bright green plastic jar with screw-on flip-top lid. It includes a pair of plastic tweezers for removing individual pads with a convenient built in storage slot across the top of the jar (see photo). The jar came in a box sealed with a tamper-resistant sticker in place. Although there was no shrink wrap nor seal on the product jar, the box was intact, and I felt confident that it hadn't been tampered with. The EXP is 09/19/2027. See photos for package information including ingredients. As a side note, these Anua Azelaic 10 Hyaluron Redness Soothing Pads are made in Korea.

avis.titre: 🌟 Gentle Brightening Pads That Deliver Visible Results
avis.texte: I’ve been using these Anua pads mostly in the morning to refresh and hydrate my skin, focusing on areas like around my eyes, cheeks, and mouth. They’re soaked in a lightweight but nourishing essence that seems to help even out my skin tone and leave it feeling softer after each use. The formula includes niacinamide, TXA, vitamin C, and seven peptides, which I’ve noticed work together to subtly improve my skin’s texture over time. So far, I haven’t experienced any irritation or dryness using them. I like the triple-layer pad design because it holds the essence well and makes application smooth without any mess. The little tweezer tool that comes with it is a nice touch — it keeps things clean and makes it easier to pick up one pad at a time without touching the others. For me, these pads fit nicely into a simple skincare routine when I want something gentle and easy to add in the morning or at night.

First off I have to say I am really impressed by the efforts of the packaging towards staying hygienic. It was really well done. The little tweezers are easy to use and I think will even reach to the bottom when it gets low. They sit nicely in the lid (see second image) so I feel secure that they will stay in place with the lid closed. The pads themselves with the hyaluronic acid have an interesting texture. I know it's from the HA forming a bit of a gel, which is nice, also tells me it is almost impossible for it to dry out. It has a tiny bit of a gritty feel to it that goes away when you massage it into the skin. It definitely leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed. I really like these and will continue to use them!

avis.titre: Feels nice and refreshing on my sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I'm loving these calming toner pads. I have sensitive skin, and my eyes get watery and irritated easily from face products. I haven't had any issues with these pads, and since I'm also sensitive to fragrances, I really appreciate that they're fragrance free. There's plenty of toner on the pads, so I gently apply it around my face and then stretch the pad over the area that I want to concentrate on and leave it for a few minutes. My skin looks and feels so nice the next morning! The container is surprisingly large, was well sealed, and included plastic tweezers to help remove individual pads. The generous quantity of 90 pads is a nice value and should last me a while!

After struggling with oily, acne-prone skin, I finally found a game-changer in the Anua PDRN 100 Hyaluronic Acid Pad. These pads have made a noticeable difference in my skin’s appearance—leaving it plumper, clearer, and more balanced. The lightweight, fragrance-free formula glides on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and gives my skin a healthy, radiant glow. They’re ideal for oily skin and layer well under moisturizer and makeup, helping keep my complexion clean and balanced throughout the day. I also love the powerhouse ingredients—three types of hyaluronic acid, peptides, and collagen—all working together to nourish and hydrate. The convenience of the pads and the cute, functional packaging are great added perks. Overall, I’m really pleased with this product and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to improve their skin’s texture and balance.

avis.titre: Hydrating Pads -- I am a Little Confused by These Things
avis.texte: I have to admit, this product confuses me. Even after a few days, I am not sure I am using these right. These are round pads that are maybe three inches in diameter. They come in a tub with a pair of tweezers to make grabbing a single pad easier. And these pads are drenched in serum, almost like a three inch face mask. It says you are supposed to "apply to the concerned area for 5-10 minutes, then gently wipe off following the skin's texture." It also suggests you "use as a morning mask while drying your hair!" I am not sure if you are supposed to wear several pads, or if you are supposed to wipe the pad across your face. I do think you are supposed to use them between cleansing and moisturizing, and that you need to wait at least 10 minutes after using these on your face before applying moisturizer or makeup. Since I do not wear makeup every day, at first I tried these in place of cleansing at night, letting it sit before I applied my night creams. It very much reminded me of the serum on a face mask, and the way that takes time after removing a mask to sink in. The next day was a no makeup day for me, so I tried them post cleansing my face in the shower, and again, swiped the pad all over my face then let the serum sink in before applying a day cream. I did like the way they made my face feel, but I did not experience the cooling effect the product page promised. To be honest, I will not be using these on makeup days, because I do not generally want to add another 10-15 min

I’m surprised these aren’t the most hyped Anua product. They have cleaned my pores out and greatly reduced the appearance of pores and even fine lines. I’m extremely impressed. Good price point too. Use them daily. They’re gentle. No irritation. I also love that they come with little plastic tweezers so I don’t have to put my fingers in the jar.

avis.titre: Left my face feeling super sticky
avis.texte: I really wanted to like these pads, but they make my face extremely sticky! I tried them multiple times with the same result. I thought that maybe after the liquid solution dried on my face that it wouldn't be sticky anymore, but nope, it stays sticky. I was sure to adhere to the directions, but nothing I did made a difference. One thing that helped was putting on serum and moisturizing cream on after using these pads. Doing that helped cover up the stickiness. On the positive side, they do amazing at removing embedded dirt off your face. I washed my face prior to using these pads and was shocked at all the dirt and residue my regular face cleaning wipes left behind. These pads did great at removing all of the dirt and residue that my regular wipes could not. I love that they come with little tweezers affixed to the lid of the container. This is a genius approach to keeping the pads free from germs and contaminants. Overall, they work, just wished they didn't make my face so sticky.

avis.titre: Cooling and hydrating serum wipes soften and moisturize, gentle for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I'm thrilled with these Hyaluronic Acid Catechin Calming Pads by Anua that I ordered from Amazon. The jar contains 110 daily use serum wipes. The formula is gentle, soothing, and really works to cool my skin as it provides hydration. The serum the pads are coated in is a clear liquid-gel, with no detectable fragrance. A set of plastic tweezers is included to make it easier to dispense them individually. The serum wipe makes it easy to apply product evenly across my skin, and one pad is enough for my entire face and neck. It dries down to a natural finish. I love how moisturized and soft my skin feels after using these pads. There is zero irritation to my sensitive skin, the formula is gentle and moisturizing.

I received the package of Heartleaf 77 Clear Pads and have used them. I followed directions and used the rough side on my face after cleansing. I was shocked at what the pad removed from my face! Just look at the hidden dirt and dead skin that was left on my face! All the dead skin cells, if left on the skin, settle into pores and create blackheads and blemishes. The pads have a rough side and a smooth side. Use the rough side on your face. It does feel a bit sticky at first but it dries and you can actually feel it tightening. I would use a moisturizer after using these pads before applying make-up. I don't detect a scent in these pads. I like that they come with the little plastic tweezers so you don't have to contaminate the container taking out one pad. I'm going to continue using these pads to keep blemishes and blackheads gone.
I’ve been using this for about a month now on my morning skin routine. This pad is so soothing and I’ve noticed my skin is smoother now. Excellent addition to my Korean skin care routine!
Loveeeeee this pads. Is help a lot with dark spot. Definitely be ordering more. Leave you skin bright and hydrated.
Good amount of pads and great to use a night before you want to glam up and put make up on.

The ANUA Heartleaf 77 Toner Pads have quickly become a staple in my skincare routine! These pads are infused with heartleaf extract, which is perfect for soothing my sensitive skin, and the PHA offers gentle exfoliation without any irritation. I love that it's a low pH formula, making it ideal for daily use without disrupting my skin barrier. These pads are super convenient, allowing me to quickly swipe away dead skin and impurities while leaving my skin feeling refreshed and hydrated. After just a few uses, I noticed my skin looking brighter and smoother. They work fast and effectively, and I love how they prep my skin for the rest of my routine. Plus, no harsh fragrance, which is a big win for me. If you're looking for an easy way to exfoliate while calming sensitive skin, this is a must-have!

Not a bad price for what I consider high quality skincare. So far I’m loving all the anua products. Also it comes with little tweezers so you don’t have to stick your fingers in there keeping it sanitary.

When I tell you my skin hasn’t been this clear in forever. I have PCOS and hirsutism which cause me to grow hair on my neck and chin. I’m also a skin picker so clearing my skin has been really difficult for me. But this product has saved my skin. I’m still working on my skin picking but when i don’t, these pads help to exfoliate and help with the dark marks. Thank Anua!

After wiping on the "textured" side of the pad, I placed 2-3 pads all over my face, special focus on eye bag area. It helps to reduce puffiness while also moisturising my face. I didn't even have to apply a separate moisturizer. This toner pad is an amazing esp when you're exposed to the chill winter winds.

I love these brightening pads so much. I been suffering from hyperpigmentation around the mouth area, these pads have been helping. Just use them consistently. I use them daily and have been seeing results

avis.titre: Multitasking toner pads working hard for the money!
avis.texte: These Glow Pads w/ PDRN + Hyaluron by Anua have a complex formulation for such a simple product. Usually I look for toner pads to do nothing more than provide a bit of hydration and calm the redness from my rosacea, but these pads are not satisfied with those mundane tasks, they have higher aspirations. These pads are designed for hydration, soothing, brightening and anti aging. They are taking the hydration very seriously, because just for that they contain glycerin, urea, trehalose, propanediol, red algae, hydrolyzed collagen, and three different forms of hyaluronic acid. My dry and dehydrated skin would love them for this alone, but they are offering much more. For soothing they contain neem extract, aloe vera, japonica and more, which my rosacea appreciates. For brightening and anti-aging they have PDRN (salmon DNA), niacinamide, adenosine, folic acid, and four different kinds of peptides, including the ones that are thought to be able to signal the body to produce collagen. And don't even get me started on the antioxidant support... these pads are packed with botanicals that are antioxidant rich, which means that they can protect the skin against environmental damage. All that and they are easy to use as well. If I am having a flare up, I place them on my cheeks, and they adhere nicely to the skin because they are very saturated. Most days, I simply wipe my face with them, and since I keep them in the refrigerator this is very refreshing and a nice way to start the day.
